thread:
Cal has almost three times as many restaurants within a 10-minute walk of campus as any other school from the old Pac-12. UCLA is 11th of 12.

All 12 schools:

1. Cal: 277
2. USC: 94
3. Arizona: 84
4. Arizona State: 76
5. Washington: 70
5. Colorado: 70
7. Oregon: 57
8. Oregon State: 38
9. Stanford: 29
10. Utah: 16
11. UCLA: 14
12. Washington State: 8

Places to eat within half a mile of each campus's center, using Overture Maps listings.

Look up any campus, with the closest places first: https://www.savorscout.net/rankings/

How to tell good fried chicken before you order:

Listen to the crust. One that crackles was fried right. One that gives softly sat too long or went into oil that wasn't hot enough.

Three more signs:

- Fried to order (12 to 18 minutes is normal)
- Seasoned all the way through, not just the coating
- Thighs on the menu

Walk in and smell: nutty is good, sharp and burnt means old oil.

More on fried chicken styles: https://www.savorscout.net/food/fried-chicken
